name: Jenna Von Oÿ
biography: Jenna von Oÿ (born Jennifer Jean von Oy; May 2, 1977) is an American actress, singer and author. She played the role of Dorothy "Six" LeMeure in the 1990 sitcom Blossom and Stevie Van Lowe in the 1999 sitcom The Parkers.
